### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** No residential-rate cap, formula or glide path in any Gibbs-owned 2026 text. — —
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** No Public Order Team and no bylaw-hours position in any Gibbs-owned 2026 text. Slate 24-hour mental-health response is *we*, not here. — —
Housing M6 **—** No housing volume, composition, 3-bedroom share, below-market share or rental-share target. Slate doubling of City housing spend is *we*. — —

Written program — **—** No Gibbs-owned 2026 program. No personal campaign site. Victoria For All is a slate *we*. Named on the slate about page only. [https://www.victoriaforall.ca/](https://www.victoriaforall.ca/) retrieved 2026-09-02
--- ## The 12 topics No topic gets its own letter. Area columns stay blank. Rules as written on . A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition — "As a parent, I want to see a Victoria where families can afford to build a life, where people can get the support they need and where our public spaces and services are there for everyone." · Names affordability as a wish. No unit target, composition share, missing-middle position or tenure mix. Mention, so a dash. Slate "Double city spending on affordable public, non-profit and co-operative housing" is *we*, not scored as theirs. [https://victoriabuzz.com/2026/08/new-political-slate-victoria-for-all-launches-3-candidates-in-upcoming-local-election/](https://victoriabuzz.com/2026/08/new-political-slate-victoria-for-all-launches-3-candidates-in-upcoming-local-election/) press 17 Aug 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence. Slate co-operative-housing spend is *we*, not scored as theirs (same test as Kim). — —
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No position on unified command, co-location, or a downtown operations desk. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Slate "Establish a 24-hour mental health crisis response service" is *we*, not a Gibbs sentence. Not scored. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No Gibbs-owned 2026 bylaw-hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — No Gibbs-owned 2026 daytime-sheltering position. The parks-sleeping motive is scored as a Mention on row 23, not here. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence on encampment removal, reclaiming named spaces, or night lighting. Motive about people sleeping in parks is a Mention on row 23, not a reclaim protocol. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence on the residential rate, a cap, or a formula. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — No downloading ledger, refusal threshold, or published transfer table. A nurses-picket post asks MLAs to strengthen public healthcare — provincial, not this cell. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The CRD, regional water rates and the filtration plant do not appear. — —
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office — No vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no downtown mandate. — —
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. First-hour is not a Y1 instrument. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence on government-to-government tables, procurement, place names, cultural protocols or an urban Indigenous liaison. Slate decolonization language is *we*. Professional background is not a source. — —
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "As City Councillor, I'll fight to end no-pets restrictions and require new developments to allow pets." · Commits to a municipal tenant-protection instrument (rental pet clauses). Comparable to M9's tenant-protection half, not the same as demoviction notice/replacement, STR licensing, or the 26°C indoor-heat rule. Context, same post, not scored separately: "Too many Victoria rentals ban pets, meaning a move could force people to lose their furry family members." Slate "restrictive pet policies" is *we* and is not the source; this sentence is Gibbs-owned. M25c (parks pets) is not a cell in this 55. [https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mq64jcsbkc2a](https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mq64jcsbkc2a) posted 8 Jul 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence on waitlists or rules-based allocation. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — "I'm running because my kid shouldn't have to ask those questions in the first place." · Motive about people sleeping in parks. Names homelessness as a reason to run, no Housing First, no STEP, no 50% target, no quarterly count. Mention, so a dash. Slate Housing First line is *we*. Context, same article, not scored separately: "We don't have to accept things the way they are. We can change them." [https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/first-slate-announced-in-victoria-two-months-ahead-of-municipal-election-12670068](https://www.timescolonist.com/local-news/first-slate-announced-in-victoria-two-months-ahead-of-municipal-election-12670068) press 15 Aug 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — The families-can-afford sentence is already cited on row 1 as a Mention of affordability. One sentence, one measure. No childcare-space, family-doctor or 18–25 instrument. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear in any Gibbs-owned 2026 text. Slate school-board candidate Beech is a different person. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) — "Also HOV are still for cars. Way more people fit on a bus." · Raises mode share in a reply, no adaptive-signal programme, no Vision Zero audit, no named corridor, no calming design. Mention, so a dash. A 24 Jun quote-post "This!! This is what I want for my kid" on Bologna school streets is a reaction, not a 2026 Plan instrument, and is not scored (see working notes). [https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mp5vnfkmjc2n](https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mp5vnfkmjc2n) posted 26 Jun 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — Slate "Expand free transit, starting with youth and seniors, and improve safe walking, cycling and rolling routes" is *we*, not a Gibbs sentence. No sidewalk-gap standard, no City-controlled transit-lever list. The HOV/bus reply is a Mention on row 27. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — "Yay!! Not listed in this article is the fact that the replaced washrooms were also on the gender binary, and thus not safe for trans people to use" · Comments on a completed City replacement. Raises gender-neutral washrooms, no network, hours, or count commitment. Mention, so a dash. Slate 24-hour public washrooms is *we*. [https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mu62uidhbc2l](https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social/post/3mu62uidhbc2l) posted 28 Aug 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02
30 M25 fix roads first — No maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Business security costs do not appear. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Community paramedicine is not named. Slate crisis-response is *we* on row 7, not here. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — No Gibbs-owned 2026 VicPD-funding or regional-review sentence. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no crime-reduction number. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date

37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — No Gibbs-owned 2026 sentence naming pedestrian priority zones or a signature project. The 24 Jun school-streets quote-post is a reaction, not scored (see working notes). — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — No heritage incentives, ornamental lighting or parks programme. Parks appear only as the setting of the homelessness motive on row 23. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Slate arts/gathering/events line is *we*. No Gibbs-owned 2026 arts-floor sentence. "public spaces and services are there for everyone" is inside the sentence already cited on row 1. — —

# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date

41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews — No zero-based cycle, no grant test, no three-part test. — —

44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. — —

### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic — Slate heat-pumps / retrofits / climate pillar is *we*. No Gibbs-owned 2026 climate, district-energy or seismic sentence. Leadnow climate work is professional background, not a 2026 Plan cell. A 16 Jul nurses-picket post is provincial healthcare, not this cell. — —
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness — Slate urban-trees / green-infrastructure line is *we*. No Gibbs-owned 2026 canopy, mode-share target or emergency-preparedness sentence. Mode-share chatter is a Mention on row 27. — —
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule — No \$25M threshold, 5-step sequence, or material-change rule. — —
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response — No Integrity Commissioner, no MNP tracker, no 60-day response standard. — —

53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans — Slate gathering-places line is *we*. No neighbourhood-grant, language-access standard or Local Area Plan programme in Gibbs-owned 2026 text. "I want this campaign — and governance — to be rooted in people-power" is a stated lane / tone, which the rules exclude. — —
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — No annual survey, advance-vote or ballot-access instrument. People-power language is tone, not this cell. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [victoriaforall.ca](https://www.victoriaforall.ca/) and [/about](https://www.victoriaforall.ca/about) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · [ACTW profile](https://acitythatworks.ca/profiles/gibbs) · Times Colonist 15 Aug 2026 · CHEK 15 Aug 2026 · Victoria News 17 Aug 2026 · Victoria Buzz 17 Aug 2026 · Island Social Trends 16 Aug 2026 · InfoRadar launch wrap · public Bluesky feed [@peterrosegibbs.bsky.social](https://bsky.app/profile/peterrosegibbs.bsky.social) (retrieved 2026-09-02) · Eventbrite Oaklands Park launch 24 May 2026 (ended; no platform text). - **Searched and not found as a Gibbs-owned 2026 page:** no personal campaign website. VoteMate lists the name in Victoria nav; no Gibbs-owned promises/biography page located this pass. Livable CRD questionnaire published as a blank form; no Gibbs answers located. Instagram listed on the ACTW profile as current; public fetch timed out this pass — reopen if posts load with URL+date. - **Slate *we* not scored.** Same test as Kim. Victoria For All lines not used as Gibbs sentences: double City spending on public/non-profit/co-op housing; protect renters (renoviction/demoviction/rent/pets); preserve affordable rentals; 24-hour mental-health crisis response; outreach/harm reduction; 24-hour public washrooms; Housing First; free transit and walking/cycling routes; heat pumps/retrofits; urban tree canopy; gathering places, artists, events. If Joa later rules that an endorsed slate is a Gibbs sentence, rows **1, 2, 7, 21, 23, 28, 29, 39, 48, 49 and 53** are the first to re-open. Row 21 is already scored from a Gibbs-owned pet sentence; a slate grant would be an upgrade question, not a second mark. - **Not a source, applied:** Leadnow organizing-manager role, Together Victoria 2020, neighbourhood-coalition and federal-climate work (professional / lived background); slate membership as a lane; third-party launch recap of the four pillars. - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** One scored cell: (1) end no-pets restrictions / require pets in new developments → row 21 Close 2.0. Named quotes used only as Mention-dashes: Buzz families-afford → row 1; Times Colonist kid/parks → row 23; Bluesky HOV/bus → row 27; Bluesky washroom-binary → row 29. - **Contested allocation.** Row 21 Close 2.0 vs Partial 1.0: M9's own instruments are demoviction notice/replacement, Renters' Hub, STR (M9b) and indoor heat (M64). A pet-clause bylaw is a tenant-protection instrument, not those. Ambiguity between Comparable (Close) and Neither (Partial) resolved upward to Close. Face-test still holds the source in hand. Drop to Partial and n is still 1. - **Not scored, logged.** 24 Jun quote-post "This!! This is what I want for my kid" on Bologna school streets (pedestrianisation / M45b or calming / M38) — reaction to someone else's photos, not a named City instrument. 25 Jun Lime/Evo bike-share connectivity — Mention of a City decision already taken. 28 May "people-power" governance — stated lane / tone. 16 Jul nurses picket — provincial. Aug 14 speaking-points cover image — cover only, speech text not readable from the alt. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. No City office held 2022–26. - **Never-list:** no Lisnard / Estrosi / Knafo / Musk / Brivael / Poilievre language used as a source or analogy. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** will they publish a Gibbs-owned platform distinct from the slate; does the pet-clause commit still bind them in the Victoria For All campaign; will they sign VoteMate or a questionnaire. - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and immediately if a Gibbs-owned page, questionnaire, or VoteMate profile appears, or if Instagram posts load with URL+date. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: —** · n = 1 · under the 5 required for a letter. Sum: 2.0 across **1** scored cell. Mean **2.00** would be B if n were 5, which maps to **B** on the live set — but the rule is n ≥ 5. The live letter stays **—**. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. Compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for Gibbs stays **—**. **What the number is measuring.** One Gibbs-owned 2026 commit (rental pet clauses) against a 55-cell grid. Fifty-four dashes are silence, not fails. The card is thin because they have not published a 2026 program in their own name, and slate *we* was not counted. **FLAG.** Thin Gibbs-owned text. Slate *we* held out (same test as Kim). No questionnaire. VoteMate promises page not located. Instagram not independently scraped this pass. Row 21 Close 2.0 is the contested mark.
